subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: Where draft-PR delivery is configured, the Go supervisor shall verify and create or continue one draft PR from the attempt's private checkout on the configured dedicated branch for human approval and merge.
rationale: Existing harness protocol and operator publication authority
fit_criterion: Agent Git writes/publication are denied; quiescent verified changes publish with normal hooks; existing-PR, moved-head and merged-branch fixtures obey branch policy; approval/merge stay human
